instruction.text: Amanda is travelling to York to see her friend Claire. She hasn’t seen her for 19 months. How long is that in years and months?
instruction.sound: ssml: Amanda is travelling to York to see her friend Claire. She hasn’t seen her for 19 months. How long is <break time='10ms'/>that in years and months?

instruction.text:
Before she can leave, Amanda needs to get ready. Match the pictures to the correct converted times.

She eats breakfast for 720 seconds.
She brushes her teeth for 120 seconds.
She packs her bag for 1,200 seconds.
instruction.sound: ssml: Before she can leave, Amanda needs to get ready. Match the pictures to the correct converted <break time='1ms'/>times.

instruction.text: Once she is ready, Amanda has to walk to the train station. This normally takes three quarters of an hour, but with her bag, she needed an extra 7 minutes. How long was the walk in minutes?
Look at the train departure board and answer the following questions.

atoms.a: How long is the journey to York in hours and minutes?
How long is that in minutes?
atoms.sound: ssml: How long is <break time='10ms'/>that in minutes?

atoms.a: The journey takes 3 minutes longer than expected. How long does it take in hours?

text.text: Amanda makes it to York and has a lovely time with Claire.
